# Changelog

Changes to the eeid-toolkit plugin, newest first. Each entry is one plugin
version and lists every skill that changed, with its skill version.


## 0.5.0 - 2026-11-24

Add the independent BYOUX skill with default-first four-input discovery, early enablement planning, verified domains/subdomains, customer CSS and tooling preflight, full selected-journey UI and public V2 Native API integration, bounded browser transport, manual user-flow creation/reuse and separately approved automation, shared sign-in/recovery layout, POST-only controls, isolated previews, explicit provisioning evidence, direct signup and partial-SSO MFA browser coverage, actionable library-managed application setup with independent end-to-end evidence, and confirmed-contract account selection with active resume, inactive/another-account discovery and synthetic browser coverage, with owner-approved skill readiness.

| Skill | Skill version |
| --- | --- |
| `eeid-implement-byoux` | 0.1.0 |
